VM - 2D Array of CDB.vi

Owning Palette: Legacy VarMan VIs

Manages VarMan variables of the 2D Array of CDB data type. (*) This legacy VI has a modern successor: VM3 - 2D Array of CDB.vi

Click the parameters for more information

 

VC Handle specifies the handle of the Variable Context in which to operate on the variable. VC Handle is ignored if name_spec refers to the variable by an alias. See the Referring to variables topic for more information.
The VM - Open Context.vi creates a Variable Context and returns its handle.
name_spec defines the name specifier of the target variable. Usually, this is merely a variable name; however, additional options are available. See the Referring to variables topic for details.
value in defines a value to be assigned to the specified variable if either the create or the set value operation is to be performed.
cmd specifies the operation to execute:

0createcreates a variable
1destroydestroys a variable
2set valuewrites a variable value
3get valuereads the variable value (default operation)
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
global? (F) controls access to global variables; its function is a little different for different operations.
*) It is ignored if name_spec refers to a variable by an alias and cmd is not create.
*) If cmd is either create or destroy, global exactly specifies either local (FALSE) or global (TRUE) variable needs to be operated.
*) If cmd is either set value or get value, global influences ability to access global variables. VarMan never searches for global variables if global is FALSE. If global is TRUE and VarMan cannot find the specified variable in VC Handle context, it tries to find the variable in the global context. In order to make VarMan looks for global variables only, provide global is TRUE and VC Handle is equal to -1 (or keep it unwired).
dup VC Handle is a flow-through parameter with the same value as VC Handle.
dup name_spec is a flow-through parameter with the same value as name_spec.
value out returns the value of the specified variable if the get value operation was performed; otherwise, it returns the same value as value in.
err code contains a VarMan Engine error code identifying an error. If no error occurred, err code is equal to zero.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains VarMan VI error code identifying an error if any occurred. If no error occurred, it is equal to zero.
source contains the error description and VI location information if an error occurred.
global out returns TRUE if an operation has been performed on a global variable; otherwise, it returns FALSE.
